title: Work view: an explicit server-side search of notes and outcomes, separate from the client-side display filters
outcome: A deliberate, explicit Work-view action searches outcome, note and gate text on the server (as `engram ls --search` does). It is separate from the client-side display filters, which, after w-e803e7f5cb8c, match only loaded row fields and never refetch.
acceptance: Work view: an explicit server-side search of notes and outcomes, separate from the client-side display filters is done
